purpose: Supplement the occluded fn19-v1 local views with declared anatomy diagnostics; never replace or relabel v1 captures.
population: All twelve original mature fn19-v1 specimens, exact original parameters and generated array hashes
target_selection: Reuse the v1 normalized semantic target and deterministic tie ordering. No case-specific camera or target overrides.
wood: All connected original surface triangles retained, with original positions, normals and indices.
fork_foliage: All foliage suppressed to expose the woody junction.
shoot_foliage: Retain original complete element prototypes and transforms whose origins map to the selected terminal segment under the v1 tapered-segment attachment rule. Suppress unrelated foliage. Record every original instance index. Attachment ownership is geometric inference because the generator exposes no owner ID.
camera: Search 48 fixed directions: elevations -0.5, 0, 0.5 and sixteen azimuths in pi/8 increments. Rank by visible woody probe count, then greatest projected retained biological triangle area, then least axial foreshortening, then index. Frame the named local anatomy (shoot terminal plus at most 0.08 m of incoming parent segment) and retained full elements with a 1.35 margin. Retain full-tree depth range.
visibility_gate: No visible woody probe is a failure. Probe success is provisional: every final image requires direct inspection of the named junction or connected shoot and attachments. Hidden anatomy remains unassessed.
